verdict.rationale: Kushki is a payments gateway, so multi-currency charging, settlement and FX are a fair question. The evidence pack covers card payments, refunds, 3DS, recurring charges and payouts, but no item documents charging in customers' local currencies, settling to a merchant bank in a different currency, or FX rates and fees. Country-specific docs (e.g. /cl) do not show cross-currency handling.

support.subject: As a founder, I can charge customers in their local currencies and settle to my bank in mine with transparent FX handling
